claims.statement: A successful preregistered row-dependent exponential detector with temperatures at most tau_A implies the frozen INT-AOD detector and excludes zero rows.
Deterministic terminal-prime strata, common restricted offset universes and output-independent temperatures can be fixed without observing output-prime incidence.
The weighted selected-centre mean lower bound T_b >= kappa X^2 log X implies c_1,b >= cX after an explicit proper-output-prime-power subtraction.
Every registered stratum satisfies the selected-centre weighted mean lower bound T_b >= kappa X^2 log X.
Correct factorial cumulant growth with radius D implies ordinary cumulant growth with radius D+1.
The post-terminal collision-plus-tail edge majorant has candidate-column row sum O(X/(log X)^2).
The full all-orders renormalized local connected kernel admits a subcritical tree or hypergraph majorant.
The primorial walk satisfies the stated additive-character energy inequality averaged over prime moduli q>2X.
The prime-modulus theorem extends to the weighted squarefree-composite conductor families required by source and connected expansions.
For every stratum, |c_k| <= c_1 k! D^(k-1) with D << X/(log X)^(1+delta).
A row-uniform Hardy--Littlewood factorial-moment theorem through logarithmic order with the registered error budget implies INT-AOD.
